verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments API platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair axis to judge. However, no evidence item mentions a sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. The integration-stages item only cites time to a first real-world transaction, which does not show a sandbox exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
